promo.builderTitle: Build and change your website, no code
promo.builderDescription: An animation with subtitles, in seven steps. Many website makers build a site quickly, but changing it later needs code. On Nodbusiness a website is made of pieces: choose what you are building, such as a hotel, a shop, a city office or a company; start from a ready template or from scratch; add pieces such as a cover, rooms, photos and prices with +; tap a piece to fill a simple form with photos, words and prices while the preview updates; edit, move up or down, delete or add any piece at any time; pick a colour and see it on computer, tablet and phone; publish, and later change a photo and tap Update. A city office, a company, a child and a grandmother build their own sites the same way.
